title: AARO SCIF briefing showing only resolved cases

tellings.quote: literally a slideshow of we looked into this and this was a dead like here's what it was, right? This was a balloon.

plain: In 2023, Congressman Eric Burlison sat in a SCIF, a sealed room for classified briefings. There, officials from AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate UAP (the government's term for UFOs), showed him only cases they had already explained. Burlison was in the room and names the briefers as Sean Kirkpatrick and Jon Kosloski. He describes it to Michels as "literally a slideshow" of "here's what it was... This was a balloon." To him, it meant the office was showing Congress its easy answers and none of the hard cases.
